# Bug Report

## Summary

Describe the defect.

## Affected Area

Identify service, app, documentation, governance, infrastructure, or workflow area.

## Expected Behavior

Describe the expected behavior.

## Actual Behavior

Describe the actual behavior.

## Evidence

Include logs, validation output, screenshots, or source references.

## Governance References

List related implementation unit, card, ADR, GAR, registry IDs, or source citation.
